formulas.ascii: C(c) <- min(C(c), min over passable D8 neighbors n of C(n) + length(n,c)*(f(n)+f(c))/2), accepting candidates <= costLimit; sources start at 0, others +Infinity; axial length 120 m, diagonal sqrt(2)*120 m here; invalid, NaN, infinite or negative friction is impassable; diagonal corner cutting allowed; at the fixpoint costs are least accumulated costs, unreached/barriers +Infinity; if capped before convergence every passable cost becomes NaN.
